coordinates.locator: midpoint of the centroids of OSM way 331249625 (Chooz B1) and way 331249628 (Chooz-B2); arXiv:2201.13285 section 2.1 (near laboratory about 400 m from the cores)
coordinates.note: The near-detector hall itself is not located: no source consulted gives its coordinates or a plan that fixes its side of the plant. This is the midpoint of the two Chooz B reactor-building centroids (OpenStreetMap), used as a campus-grade proxy; the collaboration's papers place the near laboratory about 400 m from the cores (469 m and 355 m to the two cores in arXiv:2009.05515), i.e. within about 0.5 km of this point.
coordinates.quote: The near detector was installed in a new underground laboratory at around 400 m from the nuclear cores.

name: Double Chooz near detector site
notes: No overburden or depth figure for the near-detector hall was found in the sources consulted (checked 2026-09-17).

summary.plain: The hall close to the Chooz nuclear reactors in France where Double Chooz placed its near detector.
summary.technical: Double Chooz near-detector hall, approximately 400 m from the Chooz-B reactor cores.
